summary.text: Esmeralda Soria represents California's 27th Assembly District, which her official biography says includes communities such as Merced, Madera, Los Banos and Fresno. She chairs the Assembly Agriculture Committee, a position she has held since 2023.

paragraphs.text: Before the Assembly she served as an educator, community advocate and Fresno City Councilmember.
Her official biography says she is the daughter of farm workers, was born and raised in the Central Valley, and lives in Fresno.
